title: Verify Administrator can set the On Site status of an asset on a work order
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Administrator role. (setting On Site status is gated by Work Orders: Create and Edit per spec v33 / SV-8021).
At least one work order exists.
steps:
1. Open a work order.
2. Locate the asset's On Site status control.
3. Change the On Site status and save.
expected: The On Site status control is available, and the change saves successfully.
